content.value: In PCM system, the bit error rate is $\uparrow 0 ^ { - 4 }$ . Assume that the peak signal to noise ratio on the recovered analog signals needs to be at least 30dB. (i) Find the minimum number of quantizing steps that can be used to encode the analog signal into a PCM signal. (ii) If the original analog signal had an absolute bandwidth of 2.7KHz, what is the null bandwidth of PCM signal for polar NRZ signaling case.
